summary.intent: Execute Phase 26 (Observability & UX Tuning) — deploy Grafana alert rules and tune client timeout/retry constants — then clean up, merge main, and get the PR through review.
summary.outcome: Phase 26 fully executed and verified (14/14 must-haves), PR #366 created and all review threads resolved, plus a bonus fix for Grafana free-tier cardinality limits via Alloy metric filtering and HTTP route label capping.

repo: The GSD tools (gsd-tools.cjs) resolve paths relative to the working directory — running them from the wrong directory (cipher-box vs cipher-box-ci-debug) causes phase/plan lookup failures.
Phase 26 branch was cut from main at 6dcbad04; main gained PRs #360, #361, #363 after branching, causing 'unrelated removals' in git diff that were actually just main advancing.
Grafana Cloud Free tier caps at 10,000 active metric series; Kubo/Someguy scrapes alone can exceed this due to libp2p/DHT/bitswap per-peer cardinality.

The dashboard and alert rules only reference 6 external (Kubo/Someguy) metrics: go_goroutines, go_memstats_alloc_bytes, libp2p_swarm_connections_opened/closed_total, libp2p_network_in/out_bytes_total.
Merging main into the Phase 26 branch required manual ROADMAP.md, STATE.md, and REQUIREMENTS.md conflict resolution — the branch versions predated Phase 24/25 completion markers that main had.

code.finding: Unmatched routes (bot scanners hitting /wp-admin, /.env etc.) each created a unique Prometheus label value causing unbounded histogram cardinality; collapsed to /:unmatched.
Kubo and Someguy scrape targets were forwarding all metrics to remote_write; added prometheus.relabel filter to only keep the 6 metrics actually used in dashboards/alerts.
Tests hardcoded baseDelayMs=1000 and second backoff=2000; after Phase 26 tuned baseDelayMs to 500, all 3 assertions needed updating to 500/1000/500.
Original script always POSTed alert rules (non-idempotent) and took API key as positional arg; improved to prefer GRAFANA_API_KEY env var and upsert via PUT for existing rules.
Timeout comments referenced ephemeral benchmark measurements (e.g., '~44x client-side pin p99 of 227ms') — these were removed in favor of intent-based comments.

workflow: When git diff shows large unrelated changes, first check if main advanced after the branch was cut before assuming accidental commits — git merge-base helps diagnose this quickly.
GSD phase execution: if a phase directory exists but has no plans, /gsd:execute-phase fails immediately; must run /gsd:plan-phase first.
Merging main into a feature branch with GSD planning docs requires careful conflict resolution — always keep the more recent state (branch usually has newer phase progress than main).
CodeRabbit review on planning docs caught 7 merge-resolution inconsistencies (unchecked phase checkboxes, TBD plan counts, stale STATUS) that would otherwise silently drift.
PR review comments on shell scripts flagged idempotency (always-POST vs upsert) and secret hygiene (positional API key arg vs env var) as standard issues to address.

friction: gsd-tools init ran against the wrong working directory (cipher-box instead of cipher-box-ci-debug), causing spurious 'no plans found' error on first execute-phase attempt.

Merging main required manual edit of ROADMAP.md, STATE.md, and REQUIREMENTS.md to restore Phase 24/25 completion markers — the merge tool had no way to know which planning doc version was more current.

CI failed post-push because delegated-routing.client.spec.ts still asserted the old baseDelayMs=1000 value — the test was testing the constant, not the behavior, so it wasn't caught by the simplify review.
Resolving PR #365's nitpick comment was blocked because that branch is checked out in a separate worktree, requiring context switch.
open_items: 5s delegated routing timeout may be aggressive under load on delegated-ipfs.dev (external DHT-backed service) — worth monitoring post-deploy.

Grafana alert rules are ~877 lines of structurally identical JSON differing only in thresholds/names; a config table + template approach would significantly reduce duplication but was deferred as a larger restructuring.
PR #365 review nitpick (recovery.spec.ts) was started but interrupted — still needs to be applied in the cipher-box worktree.
v1.1 milestone is complete per ROADMAP — /gsd:audit-milestone and /gsd:complete-milestone were suggested but not run.
